mail/imap_session#

An IMAP session after login: mailboxes, searching, fetching, flags, copies and moves, IDLE.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let inbox = await session.mailbox(ImapMailboxName("INBOX"));
let found = await SearchedMail(origin: inbox, matching: UnseenMail()).uids();
let fetched = await FetchedMail(origin: inbox, uids: found, data: [ImapDatum.headers]).messages();
for fetched -> message {
    message.headers().first("Subject");
}
await ChangedMailFlags(origin: inbox, uids: found, flags: MailFlags(SystemFlag(SystemMailFlag.seen)), change: FlagChange.add).messages();
await inbox.moved(uids: found, to: ImapMailboxName("Archive"));

let events = MailboxEvents(inbox);               // IDLE
let event = await events.next();

Description#

An IMAP session after login: mailboxes, searching, fetching, flags, copies and moves, IDLE.

The caller connects, authenticates and hands the command channel to ImapSession. Message operations go by UID, and UIDs carry their mailbox and UIDVALIDITY, so stale ones are refused. One operation runs at a time.
